candidates.name: Neurosarcoidosis
support_spans: - Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
Extensive white matter changes with enhancement along the arachnoid surface in the interhemispheric fissure extending over the frontal lobes bilaterally
Thick exudate in subarachnoid space
lymphocytes and plasma cells with occasional Russell bodies and eosinophils
candidates.why: The combination of elevated inflammatory markers, white matter changes on MRI, and lymphocytic inflammation with Russell bodies on brain biopsy is suggestive of neurosarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Multiple Sclerosis
support_spans: - 4 oligoclonal bands corresponding to serum sample
Extensive white matter changes
contradict_spans: Special staining negative for tuberculosis and fungal infection
candidates.why: The presence of oligoclonal bands and extensive white matter changes on MRI are consistent with multiple sclerosis, but the absence of vasculitis and negative special staining reduce the likelihood.

candidates.name: CNS Vasculitis
support_spans: - Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
Mild right nasolabial flattening
Bilateral upgoing plantars
candidates.why: The elevated inflammatory markers and neurological symptoms could suggest CNS vasculitis, but the brain biopsy showing no evidence of vasculitis contradicts this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Rheumatoid Meningitis
support_spans: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody

candidates.why: The high titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody and the presence of a thick exudate in the subarachnoid space on brain biopsy are consistent with rheumatoid meningitis.
